title: Information Management in the Building Life Cycle – The Emerging Role of Digital Building Passports
bookshelves: Category: Economics, Finance, Business and Management
summary: This work examines the requirements for life cycle building information systems to improve transparency, decision-making, and sustainability in real estate management. Based on a systematic analysis of information needs and technological potential, it identifies digital building passports as a comprehensive solution and develops a system architecture to support their implementation and standardization.
